title: Text Format Painter (TextAndFormat)

scenarios.title: Text Format Painter applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Text Format Painter (BtnTextFormatPainter) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: Text Format Painter copies the bold marker to the second shape in real PowerPoint
scenarios.expected: In an isolated real PowerPoint host, the deployed Text Format Painter on two text boxes (bold source, plain target) copies the bold marker to the target (measured targetBold=True), keeps the source text unchanged, keeps the shape count unchanged, reports execution, writes no new entry in the oPenEfficiency error log of the run day, and leaves the host stable.
